messages:
Alex: Heads-up — got a customer escalation (acct: acme-corp) reporting repeated 5xx and long tails on /v1/generate around 23:40 UTC. Seeing spike in p50->p99 and a handful of 502/504s. opening war room.
Priya: Thanks. Oncall and nightshift are on. any repro links or logs from the customer?
Support: Customer provided this curl and shows 502s intermittently:

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"prompt":"test","max_tokens":256}' -v

They see ~10% 5xx during the window and higher latency otherwise.
OpsBot: ALERT: hosted-inference-prod: gateway_5xx_rate > 5% for 15m in eu-west-1. Top caller: hosted-edge-proxy. Incident created: 1759999990
Sam: Quick triage — checking gateway logs now. If it's gateway->runtime timeouts, we should flip to fast-fail fallbacks to reduce client wait time.
Jordan: I see a pattern: upstream inference-proxy returning 504s with logs like:

"error": "upstream timeout", "route": "hosted-edge" , "latency_ms": 12000

Also connection resets from NLB seen in tcp trace.
Eva: Are we seeing large batches or long seqlen requests coinciding? Could be KV cache stalls causing long tail.
Priya: Good call. Sam, can you temporarily reduce batch size and shorten max-seq cutoff for eu-west canary? Also enable route fallback to smaller quantized model for the affected route.
Sam: Doing that now — reduced batch_size to 8 and lowered request timeout on proxy to 10s. Pushing canary rollback if no improvement.
Chris: Adding quick repro steps for eng: run this against canary with a streaming request and check connection reuse:

for i in {1..50}; do curl -sS -X POST https://canary.api.redwood.com/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"a","max_tokens":1024}' & done

Look for 502/timeout distribution.
Support: Communicated to customer: "We're actively triaging; mitigation underway (reduced batching + fallback enabled). I'll keep you posted and offer credits if there is confirmed customer impact." :thumbsup:
Alex: Initial metrics — 5xx rate dropped from ~12% to 2.1% in last 3m after batch reduction + fast-fail. p95 latency improved by ~900ms. Keeping monitoring.
Jordan: Still seeing occasional 504s — the root cause looks like intermittent NLB connection resets when backend queue spikes. Need more durable keepalives and increase NLB idle timeout.
Priya: Action items for postmortem:
- Improve NLB keepalive and tune idle timeout (Cloud infra)
- Add circuit-breaker/fast-fail default for heavy routes (Runtime)
- Add synthetic midnight canary traffic to catch regressions (SRE)
- Instrument batch-size distribution in perf dashboards (DX)
- Update support runbook with these repro snippets and customer comms template (Support)

Sam: I'll open PRs for batch-size heuristics and default shorter proxy timeouts for guest routes.
Eva: I'll own adding KV-cache stall alerts and a dashboard tile showing per-route queue depth.
Support: Logged the customer follow-up and promise timeline. Will send debrief and refund proposal once root cause confirmed.
Alex: Great. We'll keep this war room live for 30m then switch to async follow-ups. Add any other blockers here.
Priya: Assigning owners in tracker and will schedule 1h postmortem tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Link to runbook: https://internal.redwood.com/runbooks/hosted-gateway-fastfail
Chris: Noted. I'll run the bulk repro and attach traces to the ticket.
OpsBot: Incident updated: mitigation applied, 5xx_rate down. Monitoring continues. :white_check_mark:
Alex: Thanks all. Closing live band — move action items into retro and postmortem doc.
